layout.title: Fabulous Brainstorm Chat — talk it out, keep what sparks
layout.description: A chat-based project brainstormer: talk ideas out with an AI partner, accept the ones that spark onto a board of ideas, features and notes. The board works fully by hand — chat lights up when you add an LLM key.
